mechanism_claim.functional_claim: Avida's record of descent is a tree of GENOTYPES (classes of organisms with identical genomes), kept by reference counting, and it keeps exactly the living genotypes and the ancestors of the living. (1) FOUNDING: a parent edge is written once, when a newborn's genome matches neither its parent's genotype nor any LIVING genotype; the new genotype gets the next id, its parent's id, and depth = parent depth + 1 (Genotype.cc:128-184, 282-299; GenotypeArbiter.cc:278-369). Births that breed true, or that land on a living genotype, write no edge. (2) RETENTION: a genotype holds one active reference per living unit and one passive reference per child genotype; when its last unit dies it moves to a historic list, and if no child genotype refers to it, it is unlinked and its parents are released in turn, recursively (GenotypeArbiter.cc:372-410, 498-533). (3) SAVE: SavePopulation writes one row per living genotype, then, unless save_historic=0, one row per historic genotype (cPopulation.cc:6362-6563). CLAIM: a saved population is therefore CLOSED under 'parent of' and contains NO dead genotype that is not an ancestor of a living one -- the shape Harmonia's ancestry ruler calls D2, endpoints plus ancestors, at genotype resolution; among the living a genome is a key; depth is an exact function of the recorded parent; an event that re-injects every organism parentless erases the entire prior record; and the founding stamp runs on a clock that is -1 through the end of update 0, never 0, and one ahead for event-founded genotypes (GenotypeArbiter.cc:49, 87; Avida2Driver.cc:91-162). All of it is decidable on files the body already ships
mechanism_claim.claimed_inputs: unit births, injects and deaths; the parental genotype(s) of each newborn; the driver's update counter; the save_historic argument
mechanism_claim.claimed_outputs: the retained set of genotype records and its serialisation as .spop rows (the first seventeen columns of Genotype::LegacySave)
mechanism_claim.claimed_internal_dependency: retention depends ONLY on the two reference counts. No time, abundance, fitness or threshold status enters the decision to keep or drop a genotype. Two holders outside the arbiter add references and are the stated exceptions: a deme's founder/germline hold is passive (cDeme.cc:958, 985), a waiting birth-chamber entry's hold is active (cBirthChamber.cc:159-161). Both are excluded from the strata by configuration, and the definedness fixture shows each breaking exactly the row it is excluded from
mechanism_claim.known_uncertainty: (a) WHETHER THE SHIPPED FILES WERE WRITTEN BY THIS REVISION OF THE CODE IS UNKNOWN: they are upstream's expected test outputs and may predate later edits. A failure could be a wrong reading or a stale file; the adjudicator's offending-file list separates the two only partly. (b) Parasite bookkeeping, sexual ancestry (SexualAncestry.cc) and the clade arbiter were NOT read; files with parasite rows or multi-parent rows are outside every stratum and are reported as readouts only. (c) The claim is about what the record keeps, not about how much evolutionary information that is: the loss relative to a full pedigree cannot be measured on these files because the full pedigree is exactly what they do not contain (refused at plan time, DEFINEDNESS.json). (d) Whether a living organism can exist outside the cell array in the unread extensions (which would leave a genotype unwritten) was checked by searching every Add/Remove reference call in the source tree and by the pre-freeze review's trace of deferred deletion (cPopulation.cc:5786-5789, 5848-5851), failed placement and test-CPU organisms: none found in the claimed class. (e) A PRE-FREEZE ADVERSARIAL SOURCE REVIEW was run by a subagent of the same model family with no access to this packet's text beyond the claims: it traced C1-C9 and found no breaking path, one named escape for I8 (stated in that row) and one wording error (event stamps for T >= 0 only, corrected). A same-model review is a defect hunt, NOT independent evidence; it changes no row's standing

strata.S_A: S_A = every file in nyx/atlas/experiments/avida_ancestry/STRATA.json with role 'expected', kind 'population', hist0 false, class_off false, sexual_config false (CONFIG-derived, frozen in STRATA.json), AND, decided from the file's bytes by rules fixed here: its first two lines are '#filetype genotype_data' and a '#format' line whose first seventeen names are id src src_args parents num_units total_units length merit gest_time fitness gen_born update_born update_deactivated depth hw_type inst_set sequence; every data row parses; no row names more than one parent; no row's src begins horz or vert
strata.S_B: S_B = the files of S_A whose STRATA row has loaded false and deme false
strata.S_H0: S_H0 = files with role 'expected', kind 'population', hist0 true, in scope by the same #format rule, every data row parsing
strata.series: the two runs whose successive saves the body ships (STRATA series: whole_genome_duplication, whole_genome_duplication_nopc_prepend; 'u 0:10:end SavePopulation', 'u 99 InjectWholeGenomeDuplications[NopCPrepend]'), restricted to their files in S_B
strata.aggregation: each row's observable is the SUM over the files of its stratum; the eligible count is summed the same way; identical files shipped under several tests are counted once per path and the number of distinct sha256 is reported beside the total
strata.row_parsing: split a data row on whitespace; token 0 is id, token 1 is src; take the smallest k >= 0 such that token 3+k is '(none)' or a comma list of integers and tokens 4+k, 5+k, 6+k, 10+k, 11+k, 12+k, 13+k, 14+k are integers; src_args is tokens 2..2+k joined, parents token 3+k, num_units 4+k, update_born 11+k, update_deactivated 12+k, depth 13+k, hw_type 14+k, inst_set 15+k, sequence 16+k. k > 0 is predicted for rows whose source argument contains spaces (PopulationActions.cc:169, 207)

interventions.prediction_rationale: an injected organism is classified with NO parent (cPopulation.cc:7626; the action passes no hints), so it founds a root, stamped 100 because the event fires after update 99 completes. Activating it kills the occupant of its cell (cPopulation.cc:1360), so every earlier genotype loses its last unit, and since no retained genotype names any of them they are pruned to nothing. Every organism after the event is a physical copy of one before it, and the record of that is zero. If injects inherited their cell's genotype as parent, rows stamped before 100 would persist as ancestors. NAMED ESCAPE (found by the pre-freeze source review): the inject is classified BEFORE the occupant dies and the living hash is searched first (GenotypeArbiter.cc:335-344), so if a doubled genome equals the genome of a genotype still alive at that moment it JOINS that genotype, whose stamp, parents and ancestors then survive. That needs an organism, 99 updates after a single ancestor, whose genome is already another's doubled -- judged negligible, not excluded. A failure of this row is checked against that path first
